value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Center for Sustainable Energy (CSE), on behalf of SDG&E, under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized statewide budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered across SDG&E's entire distribution territory, which includes La Mesa.
value.eligibility: PG&E, SCE, or SDG&E residential customers (general market tier)

value.program_or_pathway: Three pathways: Instant Review (SB 379, via Symbium), Regular Expedited Review (AB 2188, up to 10kW PV or 30kW thermal), or Standard Plan Submittal
other_conditions: Instant Review (Symbium) covers systems up to 38.4kW AC nameplate rating, including residential energy storage systems
Regular Expedited Review is limited to one- or two-family dwellings, up to 10kW PV or 30kW thermal solar water heating
Systems not qualifying for either expedited option go through Standard Plan Submittal

value.notes: The Regular Expedited Review (AB 2188) pathway carries no extra fee beyond standard city permit fees.
